summary: Lists three ways to tag roles: under roles, on a static import_role, or on tasks inside the role used with include_role. Role-level tags also apply to the role's dependencies.
questions: How do I tag all tasks in a role?
How do I run only some tasks of a role by tag?
Do role tags apply to role dependencies?

answer_card.title: Tagging roles
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Tags under `roles:` tag every task in the role.
2. Tags on a static `import_role` do the same.
3. To select only some tasks inside a role, tag those tasks/blocks in the role, use `include_role`, and put the same tag on the include.

```yaml
roles:
  - role: webserver
    vars:
      port: 5000
    tags: [ web, foo ]
```

Role-level tags also tag the role's dependencies.
